identity_keywords.zh: 河流与街巷并存的生活感
烟火食物与温柔邻里感

visual_character.zh: 城市内部的河岸平静感
砖墙与灰泥上的柔湿空气
visual_character.en: soft humid light on brick and plaster

visual_character.zh: 低调但有人情味的日常场景
visual_character.en: daily-life scenes with low-key human warmth

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 连续街巷尺度、灰墙木檐和步行视线延伸
landmarks.visual_description_en: layered alley proportions, gray walls, timber eaves, and long pedestrian sightlines

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 缓慢河水、树影岸线和低矮城市界面
landmarks.visual_description_en: slow river surfaces, shaded embankments, and low-rise urban edges

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 大片绿树、安静步道和柔和滨水层次
landmarks.visual_description_en: broad greenery, calm walkways, and soft riverside layering

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 湿润山林、石阶、树影和低雾环境
landmarks.visual_description_en: humid forest approaches with stone steps, tree shade, and low fog

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 院门、砖墙、木窗和层层递进的住宅空间
landmarks.visual_description_en: courtyard gates, brick walls, timber windows, and layered residential depth

architecture.visual_description_zh: 围合院落、木柱、灰墙和内向空间感
architecture.visual_description_en: enclosed courtyards, timber posts, gray walls, and inward-facing domestic space

architecture.visual_description_zh: 沉静的砖色、微湿质感和低对比度墙面
architecture.visual_description_en: muted blue-gray masonry with damp texture and low-contrast surfaces

architecture.visual_description_zh: 深色木构、水平屋檐线和旧式开窗细节
architecture.visual_description_en: dark timber framing, horizontal eave lines, and traditional window details

architecture.visual_description_zh: 树影覆盖的窄巷、石板地面和低饱和街景
architecture.visual_description_en: narrow shaded lanes with stone paving and low-saturation street rhythm

architecture.visual_description_zh: 靠近河道的低层屋面、退让步道和安静水边界面
architecture.visual_description_en: low-rise facades near water with setback walkways and quiet riverside edges

food.name_en: hot pot ingredients and copper pot steam
food.visual_description_zh: 铜锅、辣椒油红色、薄雾蒸汽和围桌热感
food.visual_description_en: copper pot, chili-red tones, rising steam haze, and warm communal table energy

food.visual_description_zh: 狭窄操作台、面碗、蒸汽和清晨路边烟火
food.visual_description_en: narrow noodle counters, stacked bowls, steam, and early street-side warmth

food.visual_description_zh: 红油、豆腐白、青葱点缀和热气表面
food.visual_description_en: red chili oil, soft tofu white, green garnish, and heat-swept surfaces

food.visual_description_zh: 陶罐、深红油面和厚重厨房感
food.visual_description_en: ceramic jars, deep red oil surfaces, and grounded kitchen texture

food.visual_description_zh: 竹蒸笼、青菜、清晨光线和市井摊位节奏
food.visual_description_en: bamboo steamers, greens, early light, and neighborhood market rhythm

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 强烈色块、戏曲纹样和局部戏剧张力
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: bold color blocks, opera motifs, and concentrated dramatic detail

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 细密针脚、丝线光泽和柔软布面层次
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: fine needlework, thread sheen, and soft layered textile surfaces

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 绿色桌面、小方牌和邻里聚会感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: green tabletops, small tile geometry, and neighborhood gathering atmosphere

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 浅色竹条、编织纹理和轻巧手工感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: pale bamboo strips, woven patterns, and light handcraft texture

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 纸页、笔记、旧书和柔和书写氛围
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: paper textures, notebooks, old books, and a soft literary writing mood

nature.visual_description_zh: 杉林纵向节奏、湿石台阶和山林雾气
nature.visual_description_en: cedar-trail vertical rhythm, damp stone steps, and soft mountain fog

nature.visual_description_zh: 浓密绿色、湿空气和低山缓坡环境
nature.visual_description_en: dense greenery, humid air, and low rolling foothill environments

nature.visual_description_zh: 水边竹影、细长叶片和斑驳倒影
nature.visual_description_en: river-edge bamboo shadows, slender leaves, and broken reflections

nature.visual_description_zh: 石阶青苔、潮湿地面和雨后凉意
nature.visual_description_en: mossy stone steps, damp surfaces, and cool post-rain atmosphere

nature.name_en: soft fog in low hill forests
nature.visual_description_zh: 缓坡山林、低雾和不夸张的自然深度
nature.visual_description_en: soft fog moving through low hill forests with gentle, non-alpine depth

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 食物场景应有明显川味热度或食材识别，而不是泛化餐桌
must_include_when_relevant.en: food scenes should show recognizable Sichuan heat or ingredient identity instead of generic dining

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 建筑场景应保留院落、砖墙和树荫街巷的成都结构
must_include_when_relevant.en: architecture scenes should preserve courtyard, brick, and shaded lane characteristics

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 自然场景应是湿润低山林地，而不是茶山或高海拔雪山景观
must_include_when_relevant.en: nature scenes should feel like wet low-mountain forest rather than tea terraces or alpine views

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 不要把成都退化成只有茶馆的城市意象
avoid_generic_patterns.en: do not reduce Chengdu to teahouse-only imagery

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 除非明确需要，不要默认使用熊猫作为城市捷径
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid using pandas as default shorthand unless explicitly requested

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 避免让每一张成都封面都变成围桌喝茶的相似画面
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid turning every Chengdu cover into a seated tea-table scene

cover_bias.zh: 成都封面适合在城市温度和一个清晰主体之间取得平衡
cover_bias.en: Chengdu covers benefit from balancing lived urban warmth with one visually legible subject

cover_bias.zh: 河岸、院落、食物手艺和树荫街巷比重复茶馆更能扩展城市封面语言
cover_bias.en: river edges, courtyards, food craft, and shaded streets are better diversifiers than repeated tea scenes

scene_balance_notes.zh: 茶相关封面控制在一到两种以内
scene_balance_notes.en: limit tea-related chapter covers to one or two variants at most

scene_balance_notes.zh: 优先把城市水系、建筑、食物和山林逃逸路线拉开
scene_balance_notes.en: push city water, architecture, food, and forest escape to keep the city visually broad
